rungs_4_and_5.why: Rung 4 (medium, tape M = 0.730) and rung 5 (medium, 2x far-field) are SINGLE-MESH sensitivity runs at one level each. A Roache triple needs three levels of ONE experiment; all_triples() refuses fewer than three. Neither rung owes a triple and neither can carry one. They are reported as sensitivities beside the graded ladder, never graded as a grid family, and the frozen text's 'A single-mesh result is not shipped' (:119) is what forbids promoting either.
